main_text.p: braeos, tum nonnunquam unum exemplar illas exprimit, alterum supprimit, verbi gratia, Gen.50,25. Judæi codices legunt וישבע, sic etiam duo ex meis alia duo cum tuo addunt Jod וישבריע. Hinc colligitur Samaritanos ibi pronunciare ויושבע non ויושבע; pronunciatio enim Vajasbia, seu litteræ Jod scriptori occasionem dedit illam inserendi, sic v. 15. ejusdem cap. tuum, & duo ex meis scribunt הושב; alia duo inserunt Jod. Ratio hujusce rei est, quod dicunt Judæorum Grammatici post motionem longam, sub audiendam unam ex matribus lectionibus scilicet post Chirec & Tzere, Jod; Post. Kamets, Aleph; post Cholem & Schurek, Vau. Nonnunquam Textus Hebræus illas exprimit nonnunquā reticet. Itaq; sæpe transcriptores in hoc variant; istaqve Variatio apud Judæos ante Masoretas creberrima erat, atqve etiam nunc in ipsis Israëliticis numismatis conspicitur, post Masoretas longe minus freqvens; multa tamen post illud tempus, illius oftenduntur exempla, sed qvid-

page.notes: Hebrew forms are copied as far as legible at this resolution; the Samaritan-style forms (ויושבריע, הושב) and the vowel/dagesh marks are uncertain and should be checked against a larger scan. "Gen." and "v." are set in italics as printed. The first paragraph continues from the previous page. The catchword "qvid-" is a hyphenated word-start, printed at the foot.
